about_the_game:
GOALS isn’t just about playing, it’s about mastering the game. Climb the ranks, score with style, and rise above the competition.

Redefining football games with a fast-paced, skill-driven experience that puts players in full control of their playstyle and destiny. Designed for everyone ready to step up, it’s accessible on any platform and welcomes both newcomers and seasoned players alike. By building a fair, competitive ecosystem where effort and mastery are rewarded, GOALS inspires players to rise to the top and define the next era of football esports.

Develop your club, build your squad, and evolve together on the field. Every player is unique in both attributes and appearance. GOALS is easy to learn, but nearly impossible to fully master.

GOALS is free to play*. Play matches to earn currency to use in store to generate players. Get new kits and celebrations. Keep the best players in your squad, and exchange the ones you don’t want with Swaps. See your players progress and eventually retire to become club legends. You will also see some of your favorite real life footballers and celebrities featured.

*Applicable platform account and subscription (sold separately) may be required. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire in-game items, including random selections of in-game items.

GOALS supports cross-platform matches between Windows, PlayStation, and Xbox players.

Immerse yourself in the thrilling 1v1 online mode or join forces with friends in the forthcoming 5v5 game mode. GOALS’ Simulation Engine Technology (SENTEC) minimizes input delay to ensure an optimal gaming experience.

Take part in official esports tournaments with prize money. Prove that you’ve got what it takes to become a champion.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY

Share your feedback and engage in the discussions at the GOALS Discord.

GOALS is still under development. The full game might have elements and assets absent in the alpha.

short_description: GOALS is a gameplay-first, free-to-play, multiplayer focused and esports ready football game, currently in Alpha. Expect a responsive gameplay experience, designed to actually feel like football. Develop your club, build your squad and prove yourself on the pitch. To be the best, play the best.
